title:
SeleniumWebDriver manages Selenium RemoteWebDriver instances for UI testing and code coverage tracking.

This type provides infrastructure to:
- Create and manage Chrome browser instances via Selenium Grid
- Collect UI code coverage using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)
- Track coverage across page navigations and window/tab switches

Each test creates a new Selenium session and associated DevTools instance. The RemoteWebDriver
instance is passed as a parameter to coverage methods to support multiple concurrent test executions
(e.g., during PSR runs with multiple pods).
